stem: What happens next in this passage after “Local shops worried that digging would hurt business.”?
options: The loudest place was not the main road, as expected, but a narrow street where scooters echoed between tall buildings.
Historians argued that the road should be studied before the street was repaired.
Historians studied it and found that it showed how the old city had protected itself.
A student group studied the street for a science project.
